newsitem.title: USA: True North names Donald Seeley as CFO.
newsitem.headline: True North names Donald Seeley as CFO.

text.p: True North Communications Inc, a large advertising company, said Tuesday it named Donald Seeley as executive vice president and chief financial officer effective June 30.

Seeley, 53, had been president and chief executive of the Alexander Consulting Group, a subsidiary of Alexander & Alexander, an insurance brokerage and employee benefits consulting company based in New York.
Seeley succeeds Terry Ashwill, who resigned in March.
True North filled the position from outside the company to gain expertise from other industries.

"As an aggressively growing global communications company, for the second time we've chosen to bring in a CFO from outside our industry, with proven expertise in a broader business environment," said Bruce Mason, True North's chairman and chief executive officer.

"His track record in corporate structuring and acquisitions, balance sheet and cash management, as well as extensive capital markets experience, all in publicly held companies, are ideally suited to furthering the success of True North's consistent worldwide growth strategy," he said in a statement.
Seeley has been an officer at United Airlines, G.D. Searle and Firestone.

True North, the seventh largest advertising company in the world, had capitalized billings of more than $8.2 billion. True North companies include Foote, Cone & Belding, the largest advertising agency in North America.
